# Fisher Scientific

> > Fisher Scientific is a leading supplier of laboratory equipment, medical tubing connectors, bioprocess components, and scientific products for research, healthcare, and industrial applications.

The site offers Fisherbrand-manufactured tubing fittings, adapters, and bioprocess components compliant with USP Class VI, ISO 80369-7, and RoHS standards. Products include Kynar/PVDF, polypropylene, and medical nylon connectors for pharmaceutical, cleanroom, and laboratory environments.

## Key Topics

- Fisherbrand
- USP Class VI compliance
- ISO 80369-7 medical connectors
- Kynar/PVDF materials
- Polypropylene fittings
- Medical Nylon
- NPT threaded adapters
- Barb fittings and connectors
- Cleanroom manufactured components
- Bioprocess tubing
- Pharmaceutical equipment
- RoHS compliance
- USP 661/81/88 standards
- Laboratory tubing systems
- Single-use bioprocessing
